Notes on arrival checks
This article is for pet owners
Arrival checks for companion animals

When you arrive for travel with Aurelia Skyways, our Companion Animal Travel Desk uses a calm, simple check so your pet can move through the airport without extra stress. We look at the carrier, the paperwork, and the animal's condition, then guide you through the next steps in plain language.

Please keep your pet secure and settled before you come to the desk. A small amount of movement or noise is normal, and our team knows how to work around nervous pets. If you are traveling with Ollie or another pet that gets uneasy in crowds, let us know right away so we can slow things down and keep the handoff smooth.

<<FACT F092>> Bring the items you were asked to have ready, and keep them easy to reach. If something is missing, we will explain the next step clearly and help you avoid unnecessary delay. The process works best when you stay close to your pet and follow the directions from the desk team.

During transfer, the staff role listed in the system stays in charge of the process and keeps the handoff organized.<<FACT F100>> We also keep an eye on the animal after acceptance, because the cabin team monitors pets during flight and shares any concerns that come up. If a traveler seems worried, a supervisor will listen carefully and help sort out the issue in a steady, respectful way.

If there is an incident that needs a report, we handle it right away and pass it to the right channel for review.<<FACT F108>> You do not need to chase down answers on your own, since the desk team will tell you what comes next and keep the conversation focused on the pet's welfare.

For the easiest airport visit, arrive prepared, speak up early if your pet needs extra care, and stay with our instructions from the first check through transfer. If you need more help, contact the Companion Animal Travel Desk at Aurelia Skyways and we will walk you through it.
